pollinations._comment: v0.0.6 IMAGE-GEN W-B (@pinkpixel/mcpollinations, MIT): the Pollinations image/text/audio MCP for the agent lane. Probe-green 2026-10-19 (initialize handshake 1.3.1). Free, no key; version pinned. Generation parity with Pygmalion's routes; the honest price is $0.

context7._comment: Library docs — wrapped with mcp-compressor (medium) to compress tool schemas (70-97% token reduction). Used by Hermes, Hephaestus, Athena. ECC's docs-lookup agent hard-codes this.

tamp._comment: Token compression for MCP tool OUTPUT (orthogonal to mcp-compressor which compresses tool DESCRIPTIONS). Lossless.

chrome-devtools._comment: Browser inspection. ECC ships this. Used for debugging web apps.

playwright._comment: E2E browser automation. Used by Dionysus (QA) + Athena (frontend).

serena._comment: Semantic code edits by symbol (LSP-powered) — wrapped with mcp-compressor (medium). Reduces edit errors on large codebases. Used by Hephaestus.

sequential-thinking._comment: Portable multi-step reasoning primitive. Survives model swaps. Small tool surface — no mcp-compressor needed.

github._comment: PR/issue/workflow sync — wrapped with mcp-compressor (medium). GitHub MCP exposes 94+ tools (17.6K tokens uncompressed → ~3.3K with medium). Used by Apollo.

postgres._comment: Read-only Postgres EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Used by Persephone. WARNING: gate writes behind permission.ask.

docker._comment: Container management (build, run, inspect). Used by Prometheus.

nakkas._comment: AI-driven animated SVG generation with PNG-preview self-critique loop. Used by Athena for artwork creation.

opendesign._comment: OpenDesign MCP -- 71+ production design systems (Linear, Stripe, Vercel, Apple, etc.). Free, open-source, BYOK. Queries on-demand via od_list_projects + od_get_project to keep input tokens low. Used by Athena (frontend/design). Replaces magic-mcp (paid).

olympus-craft._comment: W-M CRAFT-VENDOR (v0.0.8): the vendored Craft Apps MCP — OLYMPUS-BUILT (upstream ships none; the org census 2026-10-21). Drives the 13 ArtCraft apps downloaded INSIDE OLYMPUS: craft_catalog/craft_status (what is vendored + versions), craft_install (web lane = the self-hosted WASM build embedded in the pane, no login; native lane = the per-OS portable build), craft_update (the auto-update sweep), craft_launch (the native window), craft_exec (the agent-ready CLI/JSON channel). Free, local-only, no key; talks to the app route on OLYMPUS_APP_PORT (default 3737).

brave-search._comment: W-N FIELD-POLISH: the websearch lane for custom strategies using OpenRouter/NVIDIA (on the GO plan websearch rides Exa free). Brave Search API: free tier 2,000 queries/month, key at api-dashboard.search.brave.com (register → API Keys → free plan). Used by Hermes + the researcher demigod; locked until BRAVE_API_KEY lands (the Originkit free-key pattern).

_olympus_notes.permission_policy: All MCPs are gated by opencode.json's permission: { mcp_*: ask }. The Olympus overlay plugin auto-approves read-only MCP tools; everything else asks the user. Built-in websearch + webfetch tools are auto-allowed (free on GO plan).
_olympus_notes.env_var_convention: API keys use ${VAR_NAME} syntax — OpenCode resolves these from the environment at runtime. Shipped MCPs that need keys: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (github), GRAFANA_URL + GRAFANA_API_KEY (grafana), FIGMA_API_KEY (figma). Set in shell, ~/.bashrc, or via the OLYMPUS API Config dialog.

built_in_tools.websearch: Free on GO plan (Exa-powered, no API key). Replaces the exa MCP server. Enable via opencode.json permission: { websearch: allow }.
built_in_tools.webfetch: Free on GO plan. Fetches a URL as markdown. Replaces firecrawl's scrape tool. Enable via opencode.json permission: { webfetch: allow }.

token_compression_stack.mcp-compressor: Wraps the 3 heaviest MCP servers (github, context7, serena) — compresses tool DESCRIPTIONS/schemas (upfront cost). 70-97% reduction benchmarked by Atlassian. Apache-2.0.
token_compression_stack.tamp: Compresses MCP tool OUTPUT (what comes back from a tool call). Orthogonal to mcp-compressor. Lossless.
token_compression_stack.caveman: Compresses god OUTPUT (natural language → terse caveman). 65% reduction. Per-god level.
token_compression_stack.strategic_compact: ECC's compaction timing skill. Manages WHEN to compact (at logical task boundaries). ECC standard, untouched.
token_compression_stack.cascading_compression: 5-layer strategy: Layer 1 (User↔Apollo, no compression) → Layer 2 (Apollo↔Gods, caveman) → Layer 3 (Gods↔Demigods, strategic-compact) → Layer 4 (Demigods↔Tools, no LLM) → Layer 5 (Gods↔Demigods latent, Symphony 70-90% transport reduction). See ARCHITECTURE.md.

adopted_plugins.opencode-pty: In the opencode.json plugin array (9 entries). Embedded terminal for the desktop app.
adopted_plugins.opencode-token-monitor: npm dependency (package.json). Cost tracking MCP feeding the OLYMPUS cost dashboard.
adopted_plugins.opencode-vibeguard: npm dependency (package.json). Secret redaction before LLM requests.
adopted_plugins.http-recorder: Dev dependency for eval harness — install via: bun add -d @opencode-ai/http-recorder@beta
